title: Verify that if file contains both valid and onvalid records than only valid record should be added and for invalid reco     rd error file generated.
preconditions:
1.URL must be working
2.user should be on FMS home page

steps.action: Go to Extraction & Load Layer -> Column Configuration
steps.expectedResult: User should redirect to the list page
Pop up window for file upload should open

steps.action: Select the file which contains valid and invalid records

steps.expectedResult: valid record should be added and for the invalid records error file should be generated

steps.action: Once click on the error file download button
steps.expectedResult: Error file should be downloaded in csv format with name format of "<OriginalFilename>_Error_<yyyyMMdd>_<HHmmss>.csv "
